description: Expected `extract --profile openspec --json` candidates for spec.md. Snapshot authored ahead of the extractor implementation; marked pending-verification. A block's candidate is its first EARS-shaped body line: the single requirement statement OpenSpec places directly under each `### Requirement:` heading (col 1). `#### Scenario:` blocks hold only Gherkin WHEN/THEN/AND steps, which are frame content and yield no candidate. Field shape mirrors the Candidate contract (file, line, col, text, profile, locatorRuleId).

candidates.text: The system shall retain build artifacts for the configured retention window.
When a build completes, the system shall record the artifact retention deadline.
While a retention hold is active, the system shall exempt held artifacts from deletion.
Where remote storage is configured, the system shall replicate retained artifacts to the remote bucket.
If an artifact exceeds its retention deadline, then the system shall schedule the artifact for deletion.
